Key.German: DEFINIERE DIE PARAMETER FÜR DEINE KAMPAGNE
Key.Spanish: Defina los parámetros de su campaña
Key.Original: DEFINE THE PARAMETERS FOR YOUR CAMPAIGN
Key.English: DEFINE THE PARAMETERS FOR YOUR CAMPAIGN

Key.Spanish: Radio máximo de las zonas

Key.German: Maximal möglicher Radius einer feindlichen Zone. Feind nutzt Lufteinheiten ab 500m Radius
Key.Spanish: Radio máximo posible de una zona enemiga. El enemigo obtienen unidades áeras cuando está sobre 500 m
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌区的最大可能半径。敌人在超过500米的战区会获得空军。
Key.Original: Maximum possible radius of an enemy zone. Enemy gets Air Units over 500m
Key.English: Maximum possible radius of an enemy zone. Enemy gets Air Units over 500m

Key.Spanish: Radio mínimo de las zonas

Key.German: Minimal möglicher Radius einer feindlichen Zone. Feind nutzt Lufteinheiten ab 500m Radius
Key.Spanish: Radio mínimo posible de las zonas. El enemigo obtiene unidades áeres cuando está sobre 500 m
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌区的最小可能半径，敌人在超过500m的战区会获得空军。
Key.Original: Minimum possible radius of an enemy zone. Enemy gets Air Units over 500m
Key.English: Minimum possible radius of an enemy zone. Enemy gets Air Units over 500m

Key.Spanish: Número de zonas enemigas

Key.German: Die Einstellungen generieren eine entsprechende Anzahl an Feindsektoren. (Hinweis: Je mehr Feindsektoren, desto höher die Wahrscheinlichkeit von Ruckeln und überlappenden Sektorpositionen.)
Key.Spanish: La configuración generará una cantidad correspondiente de sectores enemigos. (Nota: Cuantos más sectores enemigos, mayor será la probabilidad de retardos y solapamiento de posiciones.)
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置会生成多少个敌区 (注意：敌区越多，卡顿与敌区位置重复的可能性越大)
Key.Original: Generates a corresponding number of enemy zones. (Note: The greater the number of enemy zones, the higher the chance of lag and overlapping zone positions.)
Key.English: Generates a corresponding number of enemy zones. (Note: The greater the number of enemy zones, the higher the chance of lag and overlapping zone positions.)

Key.Spanish: Distancia máxima del CG

Key.German: Wähle die max. Distanz zwischen der erstellten Zonen und dem HQ
Key.Spanish: Defina la distancia máxima entre las zonas generadas y el CG
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置生成的战区到总部距离的最大值
Key.Original: Set the max. distance between the created zones and the HQ
Key.English: Set the max. distance between the created zones and the HQ

Key.Spanish: Puntos de comando disponibles inicialmente (CP)

Key.German: Definiere mit wie vielen Command Points du startest
Key.Spanish: Defina con cuantos puntos de comando empezará
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置开局有多少指挥点可用
Key.Original: Define how many Command Points you start with
Key.English: Define how many Command Points you start with

Key.Spanish: Colocación más urbana

Key.German: Definiere die Position der zufälligen Zonen
Key.Spanish: Defina la localización de las zonas aleatorias
Key.Original: Define the location of Random Zones
Key.English: Define the location of Random Zones

Key.Spanish: Multiplicador de recompensas de CP

Key.German: Setze den Multiplikator, der für die Ausschüttung der CP nach jeder Mission angewendet werden soll.
Key.Spanish: Defina el multiplicador que se aplicará a la recompensa en CP de cada misión
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置应用于每个任务的CP收入的乘数。
Key.Original: Set the multiplier applied to the CP payout for each mission.
Key.English: Set the multiplier applied to the CP payout for each mission.

Key.Spanish: Penalización de CP por muerte

Key.German: Setze die CP Strafe bei jedem Spieler Tod (Hinweis: Du kannst nur wiederbelebt werden, wenn du im LAN oder auf dedizierten Servern spielst.)
Key.Spanish: Defina cuantos CP perderá por muerte de jugadores (Nota: Solo puedes revivir al jugar en LAN o en servidores dedicados.)
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置玩家死亡损失的CP点(注意：你只有在局域网联机或专用服务器上游玩才可以复活)
Key.Original: Set the CP penalty for player death (Note: You can only respawn when playing on LAN or dedicated servers.)
Key.English: Set the CP penalty for player death (Note: You can only respawn when playing on LAN or dedicated servers.)

Key.Spanish: Poder militar de BLUFOR inicial

Key.German: Definiere die Start-Ressourcen die deinem HQ Commander zu Beginn zur Verfügung stehen
Key.Spanish: Defina los recursos que su comandante del CG posee al principio
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置开局你总部指挥官拥有的资源
Key.Original: Define the starting resources your HQ Commander has
Key.English: Define the starting resources your HQ Commander has

Key.Spanish: Poder militar de OPFOR inicial

Key.German: Definiere die Start-Ressourcen die OPFOR zu Beginn zur Verfügung stehen
Key.Spanish: Defina los recursos que OPFOR posee al principio
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置开局敌方拥有的军事实力
Key.Original: Define the starting resources OPFOR has
Key.English: Define the starting resources OPFOR has

Key.Spanish: Habilidad de las IAs aliadas

Key.German: Setze den Basis AI Skill Bereich für verbündete Einheiten. Beeinflusst jede BLUFOR Einheit.
Key.Spanish: Defina el rango de habilidad de las IAs aliadas. Afecta a cada unidad BLUFOR creada
Key.Chinesesimp: 为友军单位设定所需的基本AI技能范围。影响创建的每个蓝方单位
Key.Original: Set the desired base AI skill range for friendly units. Affects every created BLUFOR unit
Key.English: Set the desired base AI skill range for friendly units. Affects every created BLUFOR unit

Key.Spanish: Habilidad de las IAs enemigas

Key.German: Setze den Basis AI Skill Bereich für feindliche Einheiten.
Key.Spanish: Defina el rango de habilidad de las IAs de las unidades enemigas
Key.Chinesesimp: 为敌方单位设定所需的基本AI技能范围。影响创建的每个敌方单位
Key.Original: Set the desired AI skill range for the enemy units
Key.English: Set the desired AI skill range for the enemy units

Key.Spanish: OPFOR gana Unidades áereas/Blindados pesados

Key.German: Definiere ob OPFOR Lufteinheiten/Panzer bei höherer AP und größeren Zonen nutzt. Überschreibt AP/Zonen Einstellung.
Key.Spanish: Defina si OPFOR gana unidades áeres/Blindados pesados entre más alto sea su poder militar y entre más grandes sean las zonas. Sobrepasa la configuración de AP/zona.
Key.Chinesesimp: 定义敌方是否在更高的AP级别和更大的区域获得空军/重型装甲。覆盖AP/区域设置。
Key.Original: Define if OPFOR gets Air Units/Heavy Armor at higher AP levels and larger zones. Overrides AP/zone settings.
Key.English: Define if OPFOR gets Air Units/Heavy Armor at higher AP levels and larger zones. Overrides AP/zone settings.

Key.Spanish: Multiplicador de unidades de OPFOR

Key.German: Erhöht die Anzahl der feindlichen Einheiten innerhalb der Zonen
Key.Spanish: Incrementa los enemigos en las zonas controlada por OPFOR
Key.Chinesesimp: 提高敌方在战区内军队数量

Key.German: Before die Kampagne mit modifizierten Parametern gestartet wird, stelle sicher dass die Karte genug Platz für die gewählte Anzahl von Zonen hat. Ansonsten ist DUWS_T nicht in der Lage alle Zonen zu generieren.
Key.Spanish: Antes de generar la campaña con parámetros modificados, asegurese de que el mapa en el que estará jugando sea capaz de albergar todas las zonas. De otro Modo DUWS_T no sería capaz de generar las zonas.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在使用非默认参数生成活动之前，请确保正在生成的地图能够承载所有区域。否则，DUWS_T可能无法生成战区。
Key.Original: Before generating the campaign with non-default parameters, make sure that the map you are playing on can host all the zones. Otherwise DUWS_T may not be able to generate the zones.
Key.English: Before generating the campaign with non-default parameters, make sure that the map you are playing on can host all the zones. Otherwise DUWS_T may not be able to generate the zones.

Key.Spanish: Aleatorio

Key.German: Generiere die Zonen zufällig, starte anschließend die Kampagne
Key.Spanish: Genera aleatoriamente las zonas, luego inicia la campaña
Key.Chinesesimp: 随机生成区域，然后开始战役
Key.Original: Randomly generate the zones, then start the campaign
Key.English: Randomly generate the zones, then start the campaign

Key.English: Manually generate the zones, then start the campaign

Key.German:
Keine Zonen gefunden, bitte starte die Mission neu und versuche:

-den Radius der Zonen zu reduzieren
-die Anzahl der erstellten Zonen zu reduzieren
-die maximale Distanz der erstellten Zonen vom HQ zu erhöhen
-die "URBAN"-Einstellung in den Parametern auszuschalten
Key.Spanish:
No se pudieron localizar zonas, Por favor reinicie la misión e intente:
Reducir el radio máximo de las zonas.
Reducir la cantidad de zonas creadas.
Incrementar la distancia máxima entre las zonas y el Cuartel General.
Cambiar los parámetros a MENOS URBANOS.
Key.Chinesesimp:
无法找到战区， 请重新开始任务并尝试:

-降低战区最大范围
-减少生成战区的数量
-增加战区到总部的最大距离
-更改“战区更多在城市中”选项。
Key.Original:
Unable to find zones, please restart the mission and try:

-Reducing the maximum radius of the zones
-Reducing the number of zones
-Increasing the maximum distance of created zones from the HQ
-Changing to LESS URBAN in MP Params
Key.English:
Unable to find zones, please restart the mission and try:

-Reducing the maximum radius of the zones
-Reducing the number of zones
-Increasing the maximum distance of created zones from the HQ
-Changing to LESS URBAN in MP Params

Key.German: Klicke auf die Karte, um dein HQ zu platzieren. Das Update v1.3 erlaubt es, das HQ in Gebäudekomplexen zu platzieren. Zur reibungslosen Platzierung werden hindernde Gebäude entfernt.\n Mit v1.4 wurde die Hauptquartierstruktur überarbeitet. Platzieren Sie Ihr Hauptquartier möglichst in flachen Gebieten!
Key.Spanish: Haz clic en el mapa para colocar tu HQ. La actualización v1.3 permite colocar el HQ en complejos de edificios. Para garantizar una colocación exitosa, los edificios que lo obstaculicen serán eliminados.\n La v1.4 incorpora una estructura de cuartel general rediseñada. ¡Coloca tu base en zonas llanas siempre que sea posible!
Key.Chinesesimp: 在地图上点击来放置总部，v1.3的更新使得总部可以被放置于建筑群之中 (为保证总部的顺利放置，影响总部放置的建筑将被删除)\n v1.4引入了重构的总部结构，请尽量选择平缓的地区放置总部！
Key.Original: Click on the map to place your HQ. The v1.3 update allows the HQ to be placed within building complexes. To ensure successful placement, any structures blocking the HQ will be removed.\n v1.4 features a restructured HQ system. Place your HQ on flat terrain if possible!
Key.English: Click on the map to place your HQ. The v1.3 update allows the HQ to be placed within building complexes. To ensure successful placement, any structures blocking the HQ will be removed.\n v1.4 features a restructured HQ system. Place your HQ on flat terrain if possible!

Key.English:
Welcome to the high-altitude Killhouse. 
You can train or take on challenges here. Completing challenges earns you CP. 
Mind the edge, it's a long way down. 
Dying in the killhouse costs you nothing, except any currency or intel items you're carrying.

已抵达高空杀人屋训练场。

你可以携带降落伞来一场刺激的高空跳伞。 
在训练场死亡不受死亡惩罚，但仍会丢失钱币/情报。

Key.Spanish: Arsenal completo (una sola vez)
Sistema de Arsenal Renovado

Key.German: Das Arsenal-System von DUWS_X wurde in DUWS_T vollständig überarbeitet — es unterstützt nun alle von ALIVE erstellten Fraktionen! Das bedeutet, es gibt keine verschwindenden Zielgeräte, Schalldämpfer, Brillen etc. mehr. Speichern und Laden des Restricted Arsenal wurde deaktiviert. Passe deine Ausrüstung sorgfältig an.
Key.Spanish: El sistema de arsenal de DUWS_X ha sido completamente rehecho en DUWS_T — ¡ahora es compatible con todas las facciones creadas con ALIVE! Esto significa que no habrá más miras, silenciadores, gafas u otros objetos que desaparezcan. Se ha desactivado el guardado y carga del Restricted Arsenal. Ajusta tu equipamiento con cuidado.
Key.Chinesesimp: DUWS_X的军火库系统在DUWS_T里被完全重做————现在兼容所有ALIVE制作的阵营！这意味着不会再有消失的瞄具、消音器、眼镜栏位的物品等...并且禁止了严格军火库的保存和读取————仔细调整你的装备。
Key.Original: The DUWS_X arsenal system has been completely rebuilt in DUWS_T, and it now supports every ALIVE-made faction. No more scopes, suppressors or eyewear vanishing from your loadout. Saving and loading in the Restricted Arsenal is also disabled, so set up your gear carefully.
Key.English: The DUWS_X arsenal system has been completely rebuilt in DUWS_T, and it now supports every ALIVE-made faction. No more scopes, suppressors or eyewear vanishing from your loadout. Saving and loading in the Restricted Arsenal is also disabled, so set up your gear carefully.

Key.Spanish: Arsenal completo disponible.

Key.Original:
To start a disguise, you need:
 An enemy vest and helmet, and an enemy primary weapon in hand.
 A backpack, sidearm and NVGs are optional, but any you equip must be enemy issue.
 You don't need an enemy uniform. Arma restricts enemy uniforms by side, so once the gear above is right, the uniform is applied for you.

 To stay disguised, you must keep:
 An enemy uniform (added automatically once the disguise succeeds), vest, helmet, and an enemy primary weapon in hand.
 Any backpack, sidearm or NVGs you carry must be enemy issue.
 Your distance from enemies: don't get too close.
 Note: there's a 10-minute cooldown between successful disguises.
Ah hell, this guy's uniform is way too tight...
Enemy disguise activated. Stay away from enemies and do not fire until needed
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人伪装已激活。远离敌人，非必要情况下不要随意开火。

Key.Original: Delta 1-3, this is Siren 1-4. Form up on me, over.
Key.Chinesesimp: "德尔塔1-3，这里是塞壬1-4，向我集合，完毕。"

Key.Original: Siren 1-4 to Delta 1-3, send your status, over... Where the hell are you?
Key.Chinesesimp: "这里是塞壬1-4，德尔塔1-3，报告情况，完毕...你们他妈人呢？"

Key.Original: All units, this is HQ. Report your status. Delta 1-3, sitrep, now.
Key.Chinesesimp: "所有单位，这里是总部，报告你们的位置。德尔塔1-3，立刻情况报告！"

Key.Original: Delta 1-3, your tracker's been moving nonstop. Is that your element? Send a sitrep, over.
Key.Chinesesimp: "德尔塔1-3，我们看到你的GPS终端方位在不停更新，那是你的单位吗？确认情况！完毕！"

Key.Original: All units, this is HQ. Delta 1-3 is presumed KIA. Assume BLUFOR infiltrators are in the area. Stay sharp.
Key.Chinesesimp: "总部呼叫所有单位，德尔塔1-3疑似已经在行动中阵亡！蓝军的渗透部队很可能在周围活动！保持警惕！"

Key.Original: You are too close to an enemy! Move away within 5 seconds or you will be exposed
Key.Chinesesimp: 你离敌人太近了！5秒内远离否则将暴露。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You fired a weapon
Disguise broken: You stayed too close to an enemy
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你距离敌人过近且未及时远离。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You changed your uniform, vest, helmet or primary weapon
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你更换了制服、背心、头盔或主武器。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You switched to a backpack that isn't enemy issue
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你更换了非敌军类型的背包。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You equipped a secondary weapon that isn't enemy issue
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你装备了非敌军副手武器。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You drew a handgun that isn't enemy issue
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你装备了非敌军手枪。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You equipped night vision goggles that aren't enemy issue
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你装备了非敌军夜视仪。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: You entered a vehicle
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：你进入了载具。

Key.Original: Enemy disguise expired. You are now vulnerable
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人伪装已失效。你现在是正常状态。

Key.Original: Enemy disguise cooldown: %1 min %2 sec remaining
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人伪装冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are inside a vehicle
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正在载具内。

Key.Original: Enemy gear data not available. Please wait a moment
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌军装备数据不可用，请稍等。

You must wear an enemy vest
You must wear an enemy helmet/headgear
Key.Chinesesimp: 你必须佩戴敌军头盔/头饰。

Key.Original: You must equip an enemy primary weapon
Key.Chinesesimp: 你必须装备敌军主武器。

Key.Original: Your uniform does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的制服不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your vest does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的背心不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your headgear does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的头盔不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your primary weapon does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的主武器不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your backpack does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的背包不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your secondary weapon does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的副手武器不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your handgun does not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的手枪不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Your night vision goggles do not match the enemy's
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的夜视仪不是敌军类型。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Too close to a corpse
Disguise broken: Too close to an enemy zone center
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：距离战区中心过近。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Night vision goggles detected

Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: You are now disguised as a civilian
The enemy is getting suspicious of you. Move away to a safe distance to maintain your disguise
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人开始怀疑你的身份，迅速离开敌人到安全距离以继续伪装。

Key.Original: This doesn't fit... Guess I've got no other choice.
Key.English: This doesn't fit... Guess I've got no other choice.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这衣服太不合身...也没别的选择了。

Key.Original: Your disguise has been refreshed with new clothing and a backpack
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的伪装已更新，换上了新的服装和背包。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying money or intel items. Store them in the base supply crate first, or just drop them
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying money or intel items. Store them in the base supply crate first, or just drop them
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你身上携带有钱币或情报物品。请先将它们存入基地的补给箱内，或先扔到地上。

Key.Original: Hey, you! What are you doing sneaking around here?
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿...你！你在那鬼鬼祟祟的干什么呢...

Key.Original: I've got a suspicious guy here! All units, form on me!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我发现了个怪人...所有人向我靠拢！

Key.Original: This is a warzone! Get back or I’ll shoot!
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是战区，滚开！不然我就开枪了！

Key.Original: Hey you! Get over here! I haven’t seen you around!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，你！过来！我没怎么见过你！

Key.Original: You over there! Who let you into the warzone?
Key.Chinesesimp: 那边那个人，谁让你跑到战区来的？
伪装暴露：未穿着平民衣物。

Key.Original: You are now disguised as a civilian. Avoid suspicious actions
Key.English: You are now disguised as a civilian. Avoid suspicious actions
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已伪装成平民。请避免可疑行为。
伪装暴露：身穿军用装备。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Too close to enemy
Key.English: Disguise broken: Too close to enemy
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：距离敌人过近。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: Entered a non-civilian vehicle
Key.English: Disguise broken: Entered a non-civilian vehicle
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：进入非民用载具。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: reputation dropped. Angry civilians reported you
Key.English: Disguise broken: reputation dropped. Angry civilians reported you
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：声望降低——愤怒的民众举报了你。

Key.Original: Disguise broken: negative reputation in a civilian area. Your disguise is useless against the locals here
Key.English: Disguise broken: negative reputation in a civilian area. Your disguise is useless against the locals here
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装暴露：负声望进入城镇——你的伪装在居住当地多年的民众面前不值一提。

Key.Original: Unable to load civilian clothing data
Key.English: Unable to load civilian clothing data
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法获取平民服装数据。

Key.Original: Disguise not available in zombie mode
Key.English: Disguise not available in zombie mode
Key.Chinesesimp: 丧尸模式下无法伪装成平民。

Key.Original: Partisan squad ready. Click on the map to select a deployment location
Key.English: Partisan squad ready. Click on the map to select a deployment location
Key.Chinese: 游击队准备好了，点击地图选择部署位置。
部署已取消。

Key.Chinesesimp: <t color='#ffaa00'>雇佣军事承包商 (15 纸币)</t>
冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: %1 PMC operators hired and joined your squad
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名军事承包商干员已加入你的小队。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, be advised. We have made contact with local military contractors. You now have external support.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组注意，我们跟当地的军事承包商取得了联系。你们有外援了。

Key.Original: %1 PMC operators are now under your command. Note: Operators' gear and weapons are totally randomized. There is a 15-minute cooldown between hires
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名军事承包商干员现已听你指挥。注意：干员的装备完全随机。每次雇佣间有15分钟的冷却时间。
冷却剩余：%1 分 %2 秒。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, we have raised some local auxiliary forces. %1 volunteers have joined your squad.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，我们在当地发展了一些协助部队，%1 名志愿者加入了你的小队。

Key.Original: %1 partisans are now under your command. Note: The higher your reputation, the more partisans you can hire at once. Partisans' gear and weapons are totally randomized. There is a 30-minute cooldown between hires
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名游击队现已听你指挥。注意：你的声望越高，一次能雇佣的游击队就越多(最多12名)。游击队的装备完全随机。每次雇佣间有30分钟的冷却时间。

Key.English: You are already placing a waypoint
Key.Chinese: 你已经在选择传送位置。

Key.Original: Your reputation is too low. The civilian refuses to help
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的声望太低，平民拒绝提供帮助。

Key.Original: We're BLUFOR, on a peacekeeping patrol. One of our vehicles is damaged. Do you have a toolkit, or know where we can find one? We'll pay.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿...你好朋友，我们是蓝军的。我们的车辆在维和行动里受损了...你，或者你周围的人有工具箱吗？我们可以出钱买一套。

Key.Original: Peacekeeping? Screw you. You've got some nerve calling it that.
Key.Chinesesimp: 维和？去你妈的！你得有多不要脸才能说出这几个字！

Key.Original: Sorry, I don't have any tools for you. I'm not a mechanic either.
Key.Chinesesimp: 抱歉，我这里没有工具给你。我自己也不是技师。

Key.Original: This guy doesn't have a toolkit

Key.Chinesesimp: 获得工具箱！已放在附近。

Key.Original: Here, take this toolbox. Hope it helps.
Key.Chinesesimp: 给你这个工具箱，希望能帮上忙。(收下货币)

Key.Original: Your reputation is too low. The civilian refuses to help
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的声望太低，平民拒绝提供帮助。

Key.Original: We're BLUFOR, on a peacekeeping patrol. We've taken casualties. Can you spare any medical supplies? We'll pay for them.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你好老乡，我们是蓝军的...我们在维和行动里受了伤，你家里有医疗物资吗？我们可以付钱。
获得援助！医疗箱已放在附近。

Key.Original: ...Take this and get out of my sight.
Your ID has been randomly changed to: %1
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的面部已随机更换为：%1

Key.Original: 你已将 %1 丢弃在地上，请离开军火库后捡起。
Key.English: You have dropped %1 on the ground. Please pick them up after leaving the arsenal
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已将 %1 丢弃在地上，请离开军火库后捡起。

Key.Original: 你在重生时损失了以下物品：%1
Key.English: You lost the following on respawn: %1
Key.Chinesesimp: 你在重生时损失了以下物品：%1

Key.Original: We're BLUFOR. Do you know a safe route to the next town? We'll pay for it.
Key.English: We're BLUFOR. Do you know a safe route to the next town? We'll pay for it.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，朋友。我们是蓝军的人，这个镇子有什么到附近镇子的捷径吗？(递给他一叠厚钞票)

Key.Original: You've been teleported near the target town
Key.English: You've been teleported near the target town
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已快速旅行至目标城镇附近。

Key.Original: Around here? I know a few paths… where are you headed?
Key.English: Around here? I know a few paths… where are you headed?
Key.Chinesesimp: 附近吗？我倒是知道几条...你想去哪？(试探性地收下了钞票)
滚远点...你这畜生...(往地上吐了口唾沫)

Key.Original: Sorry… showing you the way is too risky…
Key.English: Sorry… showing you the way is too risky…
Key.Chinesesimp: 抱歉...为你们指路风险太大了...

Key.Original: Never mind. We'll find our own way. Keep the money.
Key.English: Never mind. We'll find our own way. Keep the money.
Key.Chinesesimp: 算了...我改变主意了，钱你收下吧，当个人情。

Key.Original: The map is already opening, please wait...
Key.English: The map is already opening, please wait...

Key.Original: Click on the map to select a civilian area (within 5km)
Key.English: Click on the map to select a civilian area (within 5km)
Key.Chinesesimp: 在地图上点击选择一个平民区域（5公里内）。

Key.Original: Your reputation is too low to request fast travel
Key.English: Your reputation is too low to request fast travel
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的声望太低，无法请求快速旅行。

Key.Original: No civilian areas found on the map
Key.English: No civilian areas found on the map

Key.Original: Target area is too far (%1 km away, max 5 km)
Key.English: Target area is too far (%1 km away, max 5 km)
Key.Chinesesimp: 目标区域太远（%1 公里，最大 5 公里）。

Key.Original: A player has left %1 and %1 will reset in 60 seconds. Return immediately to resume operations at %1.\n(To save performance, only one town can generate civilians at a time)
Key.English: A player has left %1 and %1 will reset in 60 seconds. Return immediately to resume operations at %1.\n(To save performance, only one town can generate civilians at a time)
Key.Chinesesimp: 一位玩家已离开 %1 且 %1 将在 60 秒后重置。若想继续在 %1 活动，则需立刻返回。\n(为节约性能，同一时间只能有一个城镇生成平民)

Key.Spanish: <t color='#fffb00ff'>Preguntar sobre el enemigo(1 cash)</t>

Key.Original: This war's left us with barely enough to eat...
Key.English: This war's left us with barely enough to eat...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们因为打仗连肚子都填不饱...(自言自语地嘟囔，貌似觉得你的钱给少了。)
Key.German: Wegen des Krieges können wir nicht einmal unseren Hunger stillen... (murmelt vor sich hin, offenbar weil er meint, du zahlst zu wenig)
Key.Spanish: No podemos ni llenarnos el estómago por la guerra... (murmura para sí mismo, pareciendo pensar que le das poco dinero)
Grupo enemigo

Key.Original: The civilian gave you intel on enemy position!
Key.English: The civilian gave you intel on enemy position!
Key.German: Der Zivilist hat Ihnen Informationen über die feindliche Position gegeben!
Key.Spanish: ¡El civil te dio información sobre la posición enemiga!
Key.Chinesesimp: 平民提供了敌人位置信息！

Key.Spanish: Civil

Key.Original: <t color='#00ffff'>Provide supplies and aid (Requires a FirstAidKit or ACE foods)</t>
Key.English: <t color='#00ffff'>Provide supplies and aid (Requires a FirstAidKit or ACE foods)</t>
Key.Chinesesimp: <t color='#00ffff'>提供物资救助(需要医疗包或ACE食物)</t>

Key.Original: You don't have a FAK or any ACE food
Key.English: You don't have a FAK or any ACE food

Key.Original: We're the BLUFOR relief team. Here, these supplies are for you.
Key.English: We're the BLUFOR relief team. Here, these supplies are for you.
Key.German: Hey, Kumpel! Wir sind das humanitäre Hilfsteam von BLUFOR. Nimm das.
Key.Spanish: Oye, amigo! Somos el equipo de ayuda humanitaria de BLUFOR. Toma esto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，朋友，我们是蓝军的人道救援小组，拿上这个吧。

Key.Spanish: Gracias... gracias. (coge los suministros)
¡Gracias! Eso ayuda.

Key.German: (Kurze Stille)...Wer zum Teufel will euer Zeug?
Key.Spanish: (Breve silencio)...¿Quién demonios quiere vuestras cosas?
Key.Chinesesimp: (短暂的沉默)...谁他妈要你们的东西？？

Key.Spanish: Reputación aumentada.

Key.German: Der Zivilist lehnte deine Vorräte ab.
Key.Spanish: El civil rechazó tus suministros.
Key.Chinesesimp: 平民拒绝了你的物资提供。

Key.Spanish: <t color='#00FF00'>Ven acá!</t>
¡Sí, señor! ¡No dispare!
¡Oye tú! Ven aquí!
Civil se detiene.
Civil te ignora.
<t color='#15ff00'>Reclutar para BLUFOR (2 cash)</t>

Key.Original: We're BLUFOR. We're hiring locals willing to take up arms, and the pay is good. Will you fight with us?
Key.English: We're BLUFOR. We're hiring locals willing to take up arms, and the pay is good. Will you fight with us?
Key.German: Hey, Kumpel... Wir sind von BLUFOR. Willst du für die Freiheit kämpfen? (reicht ihm ein paar Geldscheine)
Key.Spanish: Oye, amigo... Somos de BLUFOR. ¿Quieres luchar por la libertad? (dándole unos billetes)
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿，朋友...我们是蓝军的，你愿意为了自由而战吗？(递过去几张纸币)

Key.Original: ...Who the hell wants to go with you? You're just a bunch of bandits!
Key.English: ...Who the hell wants to go with you? You're just a bunch of bandits!
Key.German: ...Wer zum Teufel will mit euch gehen? Ihr seid nur ein Haufen Banditen! (schlägt dein Geld auf den Boden)
Key.Spanish: ...¿Quién demonios quiere ir con vosotros? Solo sois un montón de bandidos! (golpeando tu dinero contra el suelo)
Key.Chinesesimp: ...谁他妈要跟你们走？一帮匪徒！(把你的钱拍在地上)

Key.Original: Recruitment failed due to low reputation
Key.English: Recruitment failed due to low reputation
Key.Spanish: Reclutamiento fallido por baja reputación.

Key.Original: Fine! I've always wanted to kill those bastards!
Key.English: Fine! I've always wanted to kill those bastards!
Key.German: Na gut! Ich wollte diese Bastarde schon immer abschlachten! (nimmt die Geldscheine entgegen)
Key.Spanish: ¡Bien! ¡Siempre he querido matar a esos bastardos! (recibiendo los billetes)
Key.Chinesesimp: 行，我一直都很想杀光那帮杂碎！(接过纸币)

Key.Spanish: Civil reclutado con éxito.
(Te ignora)
Reclutamiento fallido.
¡Civil asesinado!

Key.Original: A civilian is being frisked by a player
Key.English: A civilian is being frisked by a player
Key.German: Ein Zivilist wird von einem Spieler durchsucht.
Key.Spanish: Un civil está siendo registrado por un jugador.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一个平民正被玩家搜身

Key.Original: Due to hostile actions, reputation decreased. Current reputation: %1
Key.English: Due to hostile actions, reputation decreased. Current reputation: %1
Key.German: Wegen der feindseligen Handlungen von BLUFOR ist der Ruf gesunken. Aktueller Ruf: %1
Key.Spanish: Debido a las acciones hostiles de BLUFOR, la reputación ha disminuido. Reputación actual: %1
Key.Chinesesimp: 由于蓝军的恶劣行径，声望降低。目前声望：%1

Key.Spanish: Su reputación es de: %1
controlar por la fuerza
Registrar
¡Manos arriba!

Key.German: ...? Was habe ich getan?? (hebt langsam die Hände)
Key.Spanish: ...? ¿Qué he hecho?? (levanta las manos despacio)
¡Jódete!
¡Civil se rinde!
¡Civil huye!

Key.German: Tut mir leid, nur für Ordnung.
Key.Spanish: Lo siento, solo mantengo el orden.
Key.Chinesesimp: 对不住了，只是为了维护治安。

Key.Original: Well, well... what have we here?
Key.English: Well, well... what have we here?
Key.German: Heh... du Bastard... Hey! Ich habe etwas Interessantes gefunden!
Key.Spanish: Je... hijo de puta... Oye! He encontrado algo interesante!
Key.Chinesesimp: 哈哈...你这狗杂碎...嘿！我这儿找到了点有意思的！

Key.Original: Huh? Who gave you these devices?
Key.English: Huh? Who gave you these devices?
Key.German: Hm? Wer hat dir diese Geräte gegeben?
Key.Spanish: ¿Eh? ¿Quién te dio estos equipos?

Key.Original: It's war. You won't be needing this.
Key.English: It's war. You won't be needing this.
Key.German: Das ist verdammter Krieg, Bruder... du brauchst das nicht.
Key.Spanish: Es una puta guerra, hermano... no necesitas esto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这他妈是战争，兄弟...你不需要这些东西。

Key.Original: I knew we'd find something good...
Key.English: I knew we'd find something good...
Key.German: Ich wusste, wir finden etwas Gutes...
Key.Spanish: Sabía que encontraríamos algo bueno...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我就说总归能找到点好东西...

Key.Spanish: Nada? Vale.
¡Electrónica encontrada!
¡Dinero encontrado!
Un poco de dinero
Nada útil...
¡Ve al infierno!!!

Key.Original: Civilian pulled out a hidden weapon!
Key.English: Civilian pulled out a hidden weapon!
Key.Spanish: ¡El civil sacó un arma oculta!
Key.Chinesesimp: 平民掏出了隐藏起来的武器！

Key.Spanish: A player has entered %1.
Pueblo Fantasma

Key.Original: Due to war and humanitarian disaster, %1 has no survivors left
Key.English: Due to war and humanitarian disaster, %1 has no survivors left
Key.Chinesesimp: 由于战争与人道主义灾难，城镇 %1 已无人生还。
Key.Spanish: Debido a la guerra y al desastre humanitario, el pueblo %1 no tiene supervivientes.
Key.German: Aufgrund von Krieg und humanitärer Katastrophe hat die Stadt %1 keine Überlebenden mehr.

Key.Original: The town's residents offer several interaction options
Key.English: The town's residents offer several interaction options
Key.German: Die Bewohner der Stadt bieten mehrere Interaktionsmöglichkeiten.
Key.Spanish: Los residentes del pueblo ofrecen varias opciones de interacción.
Key.Chinesesimp: 城镇内的居民提供多种交互选项。

Key.Original: We're BLUFOR. Have you seen any enemy activity in the area? We'll pay for good information.
Key.English: We're BLUFOR. Have you seen any enemy activity in the area? We'll pay for good information.
Key.German: Hallo! Hast du die Position des feindlichen Abschaums gesehen? (zieht einen Stapel lokaler Geldscheine heraus)
Key.Spanish: ¡Hola! ¿Has visto la ubicación de los enemigos escoria? (saca un montón de dinero local)
Key.Chinesesimp: 你好老乡！最近有见到匪军的位置吗？(掏出一叠当地货币)

Key.Original: Yeah, I know a few. Go give those bastards hell, they're right here on the map...
Key.English: Yeah, I know a few. Go give those bastards hell, they're right here on the map...
Key.German: Äh... Ich weiß! Tritt diesen Abschaum richtig in den Arsch! Sie sind genau hier auf der Karte...(spricht, während er die Geldscheine nimmt)
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡Lo sé! ¡Dales una buena paliza a esos escoria! Están justo aquí en el mapa...(hablando mientras coge los billetes)
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃...我知道！帮我狠狠踢那群杂碎的屁股！他们在地图的这里...(边说边收下纸币)

Key.Original: I don't know... Don't ask me...
Key.English: I don't know... Don't ask me...
Key.German: Ich weiß nicht... Frag mich nicht...(geht ängstlich weg und nimmt das Geld nicht einmal mit)
Key.Spanish: No sé... No me preguntes...(se va asustado, sin siquiera coger el dinero)
Key.Chinesesimp: 不知道...别问我...(害怕地走了，连钱都没拿)

Key.Original: Doesn't seem like it. Nothing out of the ordinary around here lately.
Key.English: Doesn't seem like it. Nothing out of the ordinary around here lately.
Key.German: Scheint nicht so. In letzter Zeit ist hier nichts Ungewöhnliches passiert. (nimmt die Geldscheine und steckt sie in seine Tasche)
Key.Spanish: Parece que no. Nada fuera de lo común por aquí últimamente. (coge los billetes y los mete en el bolsillo)
Key.Chinesesimp: 貌似没有，最近周围没什么异常。(收下纸币塞进兜里)

Key.Original: Alright... The area should be safe.
Key.English: Alright... The area should be safe.
Key.German: Na gut... Die Gegend sollte sicher sein.
Key.Spanish: Muy bien... La zona debería estar a salvo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 好吧...周围应该是安全的。

Key.Spanish: El civil no sabe nada.

Key.German: Der Zivilist weigert sich zu kooperieren.
Key.Spanish: El civil se niega a cooperar.
No se encontraron grupos enemigos.
Key.Chinesesimp: 没有发现任何敌人小队。

Key.Original: The civilian has joined your squad. Take them back to HQ for a reward. They may panic and break formation, so repeat the regroup command to keep them in line.
Key.English: The civilian has joined your squad. Take them back to HQ for a reward. They may panic and break formation, so repeat the regroup command to keep them in line.
Key.Chinesesimp: 平民已加入你的小队，带领他们返回基地以获得奖励。平民可能因恐慌而不受控制————多次下达集合命令以控制他们。

Key.Original: This civilian has already been approached
Key.English: This civilian has already been approached

Key.Original: Each evacuated civilian grants your team %1 CP
Key.English: Each evacuated civilian grants your team %1 CP
Key.Chinesesimp: 每个被撤离的平民都会带给你的队伍%1CP。

Key.German: Hey! Es ist hier gefährlich. Wir bringen dich an einen sicheren Ort!
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! Es peligroso aquí. Te llevaremos a un lugar seguro!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿！这里很危险，我们带你去安全的地方！
Key.Original: It's not safe here. We'll get you to safety.
Key.English: It's not safe here. We'll get you to safety.

Key.Spanish: Superviviente

Key.German: Äh... okay! Ich folge euch! Alle sind durchgeknallt...
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡vale! ¡Os seguiré! Todo el mundo se ha vuelto loco...
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃...好吧！我会跟着你们！所有人都疯了...
Key.Original: Uh... okay! I'll follow you! Everyone's gone crazy...
Key.English: Uh... okay! I'll follow you! Everyone's gone crazy...

Key.Spanish: ¡No te alejes!

Key.German: Das ist es. Ein Evakuierungshubschrauber wird euch gleich abholen.
Key.Spanish: Aquí es. Un helicóptero de evacuación os recogerá en breve.
Key.Chinesesimp: 就是这里了，待会会有撤离直升机接走你们。
Key.Original: This is it. An evacuation helicopter will pick you up shortly.
Key.English: This is it. An evacuation helicopter will pick you up shortly.

Key.Spanish: Gracias... gracias!!!

Key.German: Ich glaube euch nicht... Ihr seht nicht wie gute Menschen aus...
Key.Spanish: No os creo... No parecéis gente buena...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我不信...你们看着不像好人...
Key.Original: I don't trust your lot... You don't look like good people to me...
Key.English: I don't trust your lot... You don't look like good people to me...

Key.German: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass es Idioten gibt, die freiwillig an diesem gefährlichen Ort bleiben...
Key.Spanish: No puedo creer que haya idiotas que se queden voluntariamente en este lugar peligroso...
Key.Chinesesimp: 不敢相信还有蠢货自愿留在这危险的地方...
Key.Original: Hard to believe anyone would stay in a place this dangerous...
Key.English: Hard to believe anyone would stay in a place this dangerous...

Key.Spanish: Reputación incrementada !
Reputación reducida!
Su reputación es de: %1
Civil asesinado
Reputación negativa

Key.German: Du verlierst 5% deiner CP und AP pro Tötung
Key.Spanish: Perderá 5% de su CP y AP por asesinato
Key.Chinesesimp: 每次击杀平民造成了你5%的CP点和AP点损失
Key.Original: You lose 5% of CP and AP per kill
Key.English: You lose 5% of CP and AP per kill

Key.Spanish: Equipo de Acción, aquí es "Overlord". Podrían haber civiles en vuestra zona. Mantened la disciplina de fuego.
Key.German: Einsatzgruppe, hier ist "Overlord". Zivilisten könnten in eurem Bereich anwesend sein. Halten Sie die Feuersdisziplin ein.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，这里是"霸王"。你们的位置可能有平民出现，注意开火纪律。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Civilians may be present in your area. Maintain fire discipline.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Civilians may be present in your area. Maintain fire discipline.

Key.Spanish: Action Squad, aquí "Overlord". Infección confirmada en tu zona. Se te permite abrir fuego contra los infectados a voluntad. Pero ten cuidado — la posibilidad de supervivientes no ha sido descartada.
Key.German: Action Squad, hier ist "Overlord". Infektion in Ihrem Gebiet bestätigt. Freies Feuer auf Infizierte genehmigt. Seien Sie vorsichtig — die Möglichkeit von Überlebenden ist nicht ausgeschlossen.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，这里是"霸王"。你的区域已被证实发生感染，你被允许对感染者自由开火。不过还是小心点————出现幸存者的可能尚未被排除。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Infection confirmed in your area. You're cleared to engage the infected at will, but stay sharp: there may still be survivors.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Infection confirmed in your area. You're cleared to engage the infected at will, but stay sharp: there may still be survivors.

Key.Spanish: Todas las unidades, atención. Civiles armados detectados en la zona urbana! Objetivos hostiles confirmados!
Key.German: Alle Einheiten, Achtung. Bewaffnete Zivilisten im Stadtgebiet entdeckt! Als feindliche Ziele bestätigt!
Key.Chinesesimp: 所有单位注意，城区发现武装平民！确认他们为敌对目标!
Key.Original: All units, be advised. Armed civilians detected in urban area! Confirmed hostile targets!
Key.English: All units, be advised. Armed civilians detected in urban area! Confirmed hostile targets!

Key.Spanish: Todas las unidades, atención. Aquí es "Overlord 1-1". El equipo de daños colaterales ha progresado localmente. No arruinen la reputación ganada con esfuerzo de BLUFOR.
Key.German: Alle Einheiten, Achtung. Hier ist "Overlord 1-1". Das Kollateralschaden-Team hat Fortschritte lokal erzielt. Ruiniert nicht den hart erarbeiteten Ruf von BLUFOR.
Key.Chinesesimp: 所有单位注意，这里是"霸王1-1"，连带损伤处理小组在当地取得了进展。不要再把他们辛苦经营的我军名声毁了。
Key.Original: All units, this is Overlord. We've been making headway with the locals. Don't throw away the reputation BLUFOR has worked for.
Key.English: All units, this is Overlord. We've been making headway with the locals. Don't throw away the reputation BLUFOR has worked for.

Key.Spanish: Fondos insuficientes
<t color='#fffb00ff'>Desarrollar informante(5 dinero)</t>

Key.English: An informant is now active in a local town. Enemy intel around the town updates every minute
Key.Chinesesimp: 一个当地城镇现已配备了线人，每分钟会更新一次城镇周边的敌人信息。
Key.German: Eine lokale Ortschaft wurde nun mit einem Informanten ausgestattet. Die Feindinformationen rund um die Ortschaft werden jede Minute aktualisiert.
Key.Spanish: Un pueblo local ahora cuenta con un informante. La información de los enemigos alrededor del pueblo se actualiza cada minuto.

Key.English: We're BLUFOR. We'll pay you to watch the town and report any OPFOR movement. Can you do that?
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿...最近日子过得不太好，对吧？我们是蓝方的，需要你这几天在镇子看看周围有没有红方的踪迹...(塞入一大叠当地纸币和定位器)
Key.German: Hey... Die letzten Tage waren hart, nicht wahr? Wir sind von BLUFOR. Wir brauchen dich, dass du in diesen Tagen in der Stadt nach Spuren von OPFOR Ausschau hältst... (steckt einen dicken Stapel lokaler Geldscheine und einen Ortungsempfänger ein)
Key.Spanish: Oye... Los últimos tiempos han sido duros, ¿verdad? Somos de BLUFOR. Necesitamos que vigiles los alrededores del pueblo estos días por si hay rastro de OPFOR... (mete un montón de billetes locales y un localizador)
…¡Fuera!

Key.Chinesesimp: ...我考虑考虑...(很明显他不愿意干这个事，连钱都没拿)
Key.German: ...Ich überlege es mir... (Es ist offensichtlich, dass er das nicht tun will, hat das Geld nicht einmal mitgenommen.)
Key.Spanish: ...Lo pensaré... (Es obvio que no quiere hacer esto, hi siquiera cogió el dinero.)

Key.English: ...Alright, I'll keep an eye on things around here from time to time.
Key.Chinesesimp: ...(短暂迟疑)好，我会时不时在周围看看的。(拿走钱和定位器)
Key.German: ...(zögert kurz) Gut, ich werde ab und zu hier in der Umgebung Ausschau halten. (nimmt das Geld und den Ortungsempfänger)
Key.Spanish: ...(se detiene brevemente) Vale, estaré vigilando los alrededores de vez en cuando. (coge el dinero y el localizador)

Key.English: Sir, you're offering too little... I really can't do much with this amount.
Key.Chinesesimp: 先生，你给的太少了...这么少我实在很难办啊。
Key.German: Herr, Sie geben zu wenig... Damit kann ich wirklich nichts anfangen.
Key.Spanish: Señor, da muy poco... Con tan poco, realmente no puedo hacer nada.

Key.English: This town already has an active informant
Key.Chinesesimp: 该城镇已有一个活跃线人。
Key.German: Diese Stadt hat bereits einen aktiven Informanten.
Key.Spanish: Esta ciudad ya tiene un informante activo.

Key.English: Your reputation is too low to develop an informant
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的声望太低，无法发展线人。
Key.German: Dein Ruf ist zu niedrig, um einen Informanten zu entwickeln.
Key.Spanish: Tu reputación es demasiado baja para desarrollar un informante.

Key.English: Failed to recruit an informant. (Raise your reputation or keep trying; the odds are low.)
Key.Chinesesimp: 发展线人失败。(提升声望或多试几次————发展线人成功的概率很低)
Key.German: Fehler beim Entwickeln des Informanten. (Ruf erhöhen oder mehrmals versuchen — die Chance, einen Informanten erfolgreich anzuwerben, ist sehr gering.)
Key.Spanish: Fallo al desarrollar informante. (Aumenta la reputación o inténtalo varias veces — la probabilidad de reclutar a un informante con éxito es muy baja.)

Key.English: Informant developed successfully! You'll receive intel on enemy positions in this area over the next 1-3 hours
Key.Chinesesimp: 线人发展成功！你将在接下来的一到三小时内收到关于该区域敌人位置的情报。
Key.German: Informant erfolgreich angeworben! Du erhältst in den nächsten 1 bis 3 Stunden Informationen über die Feindpositionen in diesem Gebiet.
Key.Spanish: ¡Informante reclutado con éxito! Recibirás inteligencia sobre la posición de los enemigos en esta zona durante las próximas 1 a 3 horas.

Key.English: The informant in one of your towns has stopped reporting. He may have been captured by the enemy
Key.Chinesesimp: 某城镇的线人已停止报告。他可能已经被敌人逮捕了。
Key.German: Der Informant in einer Ihrer Städte hat aufgehört zu berichten. Er wurde möglicherweise vom Feind festgenommen.
Key.Spanish: El informante en una de tus ciudades ha dejado de informar. Probablemente ha sido capturado por el enemigo.

Key.German: ...(kurze Stille) Verpiss dich! (schlägt das Geld weg)
Key.Spanish: ...(breve silencio) ¡Jódete! (golpea el dinero y lo envía volando)
Key.Chinesesimp: ...(短暂沉默)滚开！(将钱打飞出去)

Key.Spanish: Informanten

Key.German: (Zzzzt...) Hallo? Kann mich jemand hören? Ich bin kompromittiert! Hilf mir, irgendjemand! Ich will nicht hier wegen ein bisschen Geld sterben!
Key.Spanish: (Zzzzt...) ¿Hola? ¿Alguien puede oírme? Estoy comprometido! Venid a ayudarme, cualquiera! No quiero morir aquí por algo de dinero!
Key.Chinesesimp: (Zzzzt...)喂？谁能听见我说话？我被发现了！快来帮帮我，谁都行！我不想为了点儿钱死在这！
Key.Original: (Zzzzt...) Hello? Can anyone hear me? I'm compromised! Come help me, anybody! I don't wanna die here for some money!
Key.English: (Zzzzt...) Hello? Can anyone hear me? I'm compromised! Come help me, anybody! I don't wanna die here for some money!

Key.German: Hier ist Overlord 1-1, identifizieren Sie sich, over.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Overlord 1-1, identifícate, over.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王1-1"，表明你的身份，完毕。
Key.Original: This is Overlord, identify yourself, over.
Key.English: This is Overlord, identify yourself, over.

Key.German: Ich bin in eurer Nähe! Passt auf! Sie kommen gleich hinterher!
Key.Spanish: Estoy cerca de vosotros! ¡Cuidado! Vendrán justo detrás!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我在你们附近！看着点！他们马上就要跟过来了！
Key.Original: I'm near you! Watch out! They're right behind me!
Key.English: I'm near you! Watch out! They're right behind me!

Key.German: Ich bin euer Informant! Mein Rufname ist… Ich weiß es nicht mehr! Scheiße, kommt sofort her! Ich riskiere mein Leben für euch! Ihr habt gesagt, dass ihr mich am Leben erhaltet!
Key.Spanish: ¡Soy vuestro informante! Mi indicativo es… ¡No lo recuerdo! Mierda, venid ya! ¡Me juego la vida por vosotros! Dijisteis que me mantendríais con vida!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我是你们的线人！我的代号是...我忘了！妈的，你们快点过来！我是为你们卖命的，你们之前说过可以保我不死！
Key.Original: I’m your informant! My callsign’s… I can’t remember! Shit, hurry up and get here! I’m risking my life for you! You said you’d keep me alive!
Key.English: I’m your informant! My callsign’s… I can’t remember! Shit, hurry up and get here! I’m risking my life for you! You said you’d keep me alive!

Key.German: Diese Einheimischen machen einem immer das Leben schwer… Einsatztrupp, hier ist "Overlord". Ich brauche, dass ihr sofort aufbrecht und den Informanten beschützt, mit dem wir gerade gesprochen haben. Wenn er vom Feind gefangen genommen wird, gerät die Sache völlig außer Kontrolle.
Key.Spanish: Estos locales nunca dejan uno tranquilo… Equipo de Acción, aquí es "Overlord". Necesito que salgan inmediatamente para proteger al informante con el que acabamos de hablar. Si es capturado por el enemigo, el asunto se pondrá muy feo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这些当地人总是不让人省心...行动组，这里是"霸王"，我需要你们立刻出发保护好刚刚的线人。万一他被敌人抓住，事情就闹大了。
Key.Original: These locals never make it easy... Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Move out now and protect the informant we just spoke to. If the enemy takes him, this gets out of hand fast.
Key.English: These locals never make it easy... Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Move out now and protect the informant we just spoke to. If the enemy takes him, this gets out of hand fast.

Key.German: Ein Lieferwagen einer internationalen humanitären Organisation wurde von feindlichen Kräften beschlagnahmt. Wir müssen den Wagen zurückerobern und zur nahen Übergabestelle der internationalen humanitären Organisation bringen. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.Spanish: Un camión de suministros de una organización humanitaria internacional ha sido robado por las fuerzas enemigas. Tenemos que recuperar el camión y devolverlo al punto de entrega de la organización humanitaria internacional cercano. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.Chinesesimp: 国际公益组织的补给卡车被敌人抢走了，我们需要把卡车抢回来，并还给不远处的国际公益组织交付点。(低CP，无AP，高声望)
Key.Original: A supply truck belonging to an international humanitarian organization has been seized by enemy forces. We need to recover the truck and return it to the nearby humanitarian delivery point. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.English: A supply truck belonging to an international humanitarian organization has been seized by enemy forces. We need to recover the truck and return it to the nearby humanitarian delivery point. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)

Key.German: Hallo? Kann mich jemand hören? Hier ist IDAP. Vor einer Stunde wurde einer unserer Lieferwagen mit humanitärer Hilfe von OPFOR beschlagnahmt... Wir bitten Sie um Hilfe bei der Rückeroberung des Wagens. Seine ungefähre Richtung und der Übergabepunkt wurden auf dem GPS aktualisiert.
Key.Spanish: ¿Hola? ¿Alguien me oye? Soy IDAP. Hace una hora, uno de nuestros camiones de suministros cargado de ayuda humanitaria fue robado por OPFOR... Les pedimos ayuda para recuperar el camión. Su dirección aproximada y el punto de entrega han sido actualizados en el GPS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 喂？可以听到吗？我是IDAP的工作人员，一小时之前我们的一辆装满人道主义物资的补给卡车被红方抢走了...我们请求你们帮忙将卡车夺回来，卡车的大致去向和交付点已经在GPS上更新。
Key.Original: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is IDAP. An hour ago OPFOR seized one of our trucks loaded with humanitarian aid... We need your help to get it back. Its rough heading and the delivery point are marked on your GPS.
Key.English: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is IDAP. An hour ago OPFOR seized one of our trucks loaded with humanitarian aid... We need your help to get it back. Its rough heading and the delivery point are marked on your GPS.

Key.German: Hier ist BLUFOR-Kommando. Wir haben Ihre Anfrage erhalten. Einheiten sind zum markierten Ort unterwegs ———— "Overlord 1-1" an Einsatzteam, habt ihr die Übertragung alle verstanden?
Key.Spanish: Aquí mando BLUFOR. Hemos recibido su solicitud. Unidades en camino a la ubicación marcada ———— "Overlord 1-1" llamando al Equipo de Acción, ¿escuchasteis esa transmisión?
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是蓝方指挥，我们收到了你的请求。正在派出部队前往标记位置————"霸王1-1"呼叫行动组，刚刚的通话你们都听到了吧。
Key.Original: This is BLUFOR Command, we've received your request. Units are en route to the marked location. Overlord to Alpha 1-1, you copy all that?
Key.English: This is BLUFOR Command, we've received your request. Units are en route to the marked location. Overlord to Alpha 1-1, you copy all that?

Key.German: Einsatzteam verstanden, wir beginnen die Operation sobald der Plan festgelegt ist, Ende.
Key.Spanish: Equipo de Acción recibe, comenzaremos la operación una vez planificado, fuera.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组收到，我们规划完方案后就开始行动，完毕。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1 copies. We'll move out once the plan's set, out.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1 copies. We'll move out once the plan's set, out.

Key.German: Vielen Dank! Zivilisten im Kriegsgebiet schätzen, was Sie getan haben!
Key.Spanish: Muchas gracias! Civiles en la zona de guerra agradecen lo que han hecho!
Key.Chinesesimp: 太感谢了！战区平民感激你们的所作所为！
Key.Original: Thank you. The people out here won't forget what you've done.
Key.English: Thank you. The people out here won't forget what you've done.

Key.German: Hier ist Einsatztrupp, verstanden. Unterwegs zum Zielort.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Equipo de Acción, recibido. En camino al lugar objetivo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组收到，正赶往目标地点。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1 copies. En route to target.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1 copies. En route to target.

Key.German: Einsatztrupp an "Overlord", Informant vorerst sicher, over.
Key.Spanish: Equipo de Acción a "Overlord", informante seguro por ahora, over.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组呼叫"霸王"，线人暂时安全了。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord, informant is secure for now, over.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord, informant is secure for now, over.

Key.German: Verdammt, beeilt euch verdammt noch mal! Wenn ich gefangen werde, werden es auch eure Truppen hier bereuen!
Key.Spanish: Mierda, ¡apresúrense de una vez! Si me capturan, ¡vuestras tropas aquí también lo van a lamentar!
Key.Chinesesimp: 求求你们他妈的快点！我要是被抓到了，你们在这的部队也不会有好日子过了！
Key.Original: God damn it, hurry up! If they catch me, you'll regret it too!
Key.English: God damn it, hurry up! If they catch me, you'll regret it too!

Key.German: Wir haben einen Informanten, dessen Identität aufgeflogen ist. Er versteckt sich irgendwo in einem Gebäude. Geh dorthin und beschütze ihn, bevor der Feind ihn einholt und verhaftet — ja, wir können ihn noch nicht aus dem Gebiet evakuieren, weil wir ihn brauchen, um weiterhin vor Ort Informationen für uns zu sammeln. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.Spanish: Tenemos un informante cuya identidad ha sido expuesta. Se está ocultando dentro de un edificio en algún lugar. Ve allí y protégelo antes de que el enemigo lo alcance y lo arresta — sí, aún no podemos sacarlo de la zona, porque necesitamos que siga recopilando información para nosotros localmente. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们有一个线人暴露了身份，他现在躲在某地的建筑物内。在敌人追上并逮捕他之前赶到那里保护他————是的，他还不能离开当地，我们需要他继续为我们收集情报。(稍低CP，无AP，高声望)
Key.Original: One of our informants has been made. He's holed up in a building somewhere in the area. Get to him and hold the enemy off before they run him down. We can't pull him out yet; we still need him gathering intel here. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.English: One of our informants has been made. He's holed up in a building somewhere in the area. Get to him and hold the enemy off before they run him down. We can't pull him out yet; we still need him gathering intel here. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)

Key.German: Hier spricht das HQ. Wir haben Kontakt zu einem Informanten in deiner Nähe. Überprüfe seine letzte bekannte Position auf deiner Karte.
Key.Spanish: Este es el Cuartel general. Tenemos contacto con un informante en tu área. Revisa en tu mapa su ultima posición conocida.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王"。我们需要与在你所在区域的一位线人进行联络，他的位置已标识到你的GPS终端上。
Key.Original: This is Overlord. We've made contact with an informant in your area. Check your map for his last known location.
Key.English: This is Overlord. We've made contact with an informant in your area. Check your map for his last known location.

Key.Spanish: Informante

Key.German: Wir haben Kontakt zu einem Informaten in deiner Nähe.
Key.Spanish: Tenemos contacto con un informante en tu área.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们需要与在你所在区域的一位线人进行联络。
Key.Original: We've made contact with an informant in your area.
Key.English: We've made contact with an informant in your area.

Key.German: "Overlord 1-1" an Einsatztrupp. Der Informant ist tot. Zieht euch sofort zurück. Wir können nichts mehr tun.
Key.Spanish: "Overlord 1-1" a Equipo de Acción. El informante está muerto. Retrocedan de inmediato. No podemos hacer nada más.
Key.Chinesesimp: "霸王1-1"呼叫行动组，线人死掉了你们就撤出来吧。我们也做不了更多了。
Key.Original: Overlord to Alpha 1-1. The informant's dead. Extract immediately, there's nothing more we can do.
Key.English: Overlord to Alpha 1-1. The informant's dead. Extract immediately, there's nothing more we can do.

Key.Original: %1 has recovered a top secret document

Key.Chinesesimp: 发现 %1 件物品！请检查你的背包。

Key.Original: Inventory full. Items dropped on the ground
Key.Chinesesimp: 背包已满，物品已掉落在地面。
任务有效时间还剩5分钟

Key.Original: All units, this is Overlord. Thirty minutes ago our assault hit an enemy command post in town. They're scrambling to recover the intel gear they left behind.
Key.Chinesesimp: 战区所有单位注意，这里是"霸王1-1"。半小时前，我们的攻击行动击溃了敌人位于某城镇的临时指挥部，他们现在正在抢救他们部署在当地的情报设施。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, you're running the follow-up assault on the post. Allseer, you'll process whatever intel Alpha recovers and handle the rest.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，你们负责稍后对于临时指挥部的再次进攻，"全视眼"，你们负责处理行动组带回来的情报以及任务后续工作。
这里是行动组，收到命令。

Key.Original: Grab as much intel as you can before the enemy clears it out. Bring vehicles if you can; the post covers a lot of ground.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在敌人带着情报撤离前带回越多情报越好。另外，搞几辆载具过去最好————那个临时指挥部覆盖的范围相当大。
明白了，我们待会就出发。

Key.Original: Allseer here. Drone feeds show most of the enemy has pulled out of the post. Once you've got enough intel, extract and we'll call it a success.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"全视眼"，无人机显示大部分敌人都从临时指挥部撤离了。如果你们带回了足够多的情报就离开那里吧，任务可以宣布成功。

Key.Original: Overlord, Alpha 1-1. We've found a classified document, looks highly sensitive.
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃...这里是行动组，我们发现了一份疑似高度机密的情报文件

Key.Original: Overlord copies. Bring it back, whatever it takes.

An enemy command post was scattered by our assault. They are collecting intel and trying to escape. Your squad must search buildings in the area to retrieve intel items. The mission ends automatically in 15 minutes. (Very low CP, very low AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人一个指挥部在我们的一次攻击行动后被打散了，他们正在收拾区域内的各类情报并逃脱。你的小队需要搜索区域内的建筑以获取情报物品。任务在15分钟后自动结束。(极低CP，极低AP)

Key.Original: Not enough suitable buildings in the area. Mission cancelled
Key.Chinesesimp: 区域内可用建筑不足，任务已取消。

Key.Original: Overlord, Alpha 1-1. We've just uploaded the latest intel to the data terminal.
Key.English: Overlord, Alpha 1-1. We've just uploaded the latest intel to the data terminal.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"行动组"，我们刚刚在数据终端上传了一批最新的情报。

Key.Original: Overlord copies. Analysis team's on it. Good work.
Key.English: Overlord copies. Analysis team's on it. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: "霸王1-1"收到，数据分析小组会好好看看它们的。干得漂亮。

Key.Original: 你没有可分析的情报物品！
Key.English: You have no intel items to analyze!
Key.Chinesesimp: 你没有可分析的情报物品！

Key.Original: 分析完成！获得 %1 CP。\n已分析物品：%2
Key.Chinesesimp: 分析完成！获得 %1 CP。\n已分析物品：%2

Key.Original: You can reveal this mission's objective location by searching enemy bodies
Key.English: You can reveal this mission's objective location by searching enemy bodies
Key.German: Der Zielort dieser Mission kann durchsuchen von feindlichen Leichen aufgedeckt werden.
Key.Spanish: La ubicación del objetivo de esta misión se puede revelar buscando en los cuerpos enemigos.
Key.Chinesesimp: 此任务的目标位置可以通过搜索敌军尸体来揭露

Key.Spanish: Buscar inteligencia
Inteligencia crítica
Se ha localizado la ubicación del objetivo crítico de la misión
Key.Chinesesimp: 任务关键目标的位置已被找到

Key.Spanish: Inteligencia adicional obtenida

Key.Original: You have acquired extra intel and gained %1 CP, %2 AP
Key.English: You have acquired extra intel and gained %1 CP, %2 AP
Key.German: Du hast zusätzliche Informationen erfasst und %1 CP, %2 AP erhalten.
Key.Spanish: Has obtenido inteligencia adicional y ganado %1 CP, %2 AP.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你发现了额外的情报，获得了%1 CP, %2 AP

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord, we've got the exact objective location. Uploading it to the GPS now.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord, we've got the exact objective location. Uploading it to the GPS now.
Key.German: Action Squad an "Overlord", wir haben den genauen Standort des Missionsziels erfasst und auf das GPS-Terminal übermittelt.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad llamando a "Overlord", hemos obtenido la ubicación detallada del objetivo de la misión y la hemos subido al terminal GPS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组呼叫"霸王"，我们获取了任务目标的详细位置，已经上传到GPS终端。

Key.Original: Overlord copies. Proceed with the mission.
Key.English: Overlord copies. Proceed with the mission.
Key.Spanish: Aquí es "Overlord" — Recibido, continúa la misión.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王"—— 收到，继续执行任务。

Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! Encontré algo interesante!
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿！我这找到点有意思的！

Key.Spanish: ¿Nada? Bueno…
Objetivo de inteligencia
¡Documentos importantes encontrados!

Key.Original: Item dropped on the ground (no inventory space left)
Key.English: Item dropped on the ground (no inventory space left)
Key.Chinesesimp: 物品已掉落在地面 (玩家没有充足的库存空间)

Key.Original: 购买随机面部装备 (1 纸币)
Key.Chinesesimp: 购买随机面部装备 (1 纸币)

Key.Original: 购买随机副手武器 (5 纸币)
Key.Chinesesimp: 购买随机副手武器 (5 纸币)

Key.Original: 购买随机瞄具 (5 纸币)
Key.Chinesesimp: 购买随机瞄具 (5 纸币)

Key.Original: 需要 %1 个纸币，你只有 %2 个
Key.Chinesesimp: 需要 %1 个纸币，你只有 %2 个

Key.Original: This is Overlord. Your black market order has been delivered to HQ.
Key.English: This is Overlord. Your black market order has been delivered to HQ.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王1-1"，战区的黑市刚刚派人送了点东西到总部。谁买的？...我是说，好品味。

Key.Spanish: Demonio élite eliminado

Key.Original: Your squad has been awarded %1 CP
Key.English: Your squad has been awarded %1 CP
Key.Spanish: Tu escuadrón ha obtenido %1 CP.
Juggernaut eliminado

Key.Original: Your squad has been awarded %1 CP
Key.English: Your squad has been awarded %1 CP
Key.Spanish: Demonio élite eliminado

Key.Original: %1 的小队击毁了敌军车辆，获得了 %2 CP
Key.English: %1's squad destroyed an enemy light vehicle and gained %2 CP

Key.Original: %1 的小队刚刚干掉了敌方装甲车，获得 %2 CP
Key.English: %1's squad destroyed an enemy APC and gained %2 CP

Key.Original: %1 的小队击毁了敌方的坦克，获得 %2 CP
Key.English: %1's squad destroyed an enemy tank and gained %2 CP

Key.Original: %1 的小队刚击落了敌方直升机，获得 %2 CP
Key.English: %1's squad destroyed an enemy helicopter and gained %2 CP

Key.Original: 一架敌方固定翼被%1的小队击毁，获得 %2 CP
Key.English: %1's squad destroyed an enemy plane and gained %2 CP

Key.Original: %1 的小队累计击杀 %2 人，获得 %3 CP
Key.English: %1's squad reached %2 kills and earned a %3 CP bonus!

Key.Spanish: Enemigo KIA!
Bonificación de puntuación
Bonificación de CP: Zona capturada
Botín adquirido

Key.German: Zusätzliche CP und AP für das Erobern einer Zone erhalten
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到来自夺取战区的额外CP和AP
Key.Spanish: Recividos CP y AP adicionales por capturar una zona
Key.Original: Received additional CP and AP for capturing a zone
Key.English: Received additional CP and AP for capturing a zone

Key.German: Spieler hat wertvolle Gegenstände von Zivilisten geplündert.
Key.Chinesesimp: 玩家从平民身上掠夺到了有价值的物品
Key.Spanish: El jugador saqueó objetos valiosos a los civiles.
Key.Original: Player looted valuable items from civilians
Key.English: Player looted valuable items from civilians

Key.Spanish: Bonus de CP: Zona recapturada

Key.German: Zusätzliche CP und AP für die Zurückeroberung einer Zone erhalten
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到重新夺取一个战区的CP点和AP点
Key.Spanish: Recividos CP y AP por recapturar una zona
Key.Original: Received CP and AP for recapturing a zone
Key.English: Received CP and AP for recapturing a zone

Key.Spanish: Bonificación de CP: Misión secundaria completada
Bonificación de CP: Recompensas por alto prestigio
Bonificación de AP: Misión secundaria completada
CP Bonus received!

Key.German: Du hast CP-Belohnungen für deinen guten Ruf erhalten!
Key.Chinesesimp: 你因良好声望获取了CP奖励！
Key.Spanish: ¡Has conseguido recompensas de CP por tu alto prestigio!
AP Bonus received!
Bonificación de CP: Zonas bajo control

Key.German: Zusätzliche CP und AP für die Kontrolle über %2 Zonen erhalten
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到控制 %2 个战区的额外CP点
Key.Spanish: Recividos CP adicionales por controlar %2 zonas
Key.Original: Received additional CP for controlling %2 zones
Key.English: Received additional CP for controlling %2 zones

Key.Original: Knight 1-5 to HQ, almost on station. ETA thirty seconds.
Key.English: Knight 1-5 to HQ, almost on station. ETA thirty seconds.
Key.German: "Knight 1-5" an HQ, wir sind fast da. ETA: 30 Sekunden.
Key.Spanish: "Knight 1-5" al HQ, casi llegamos. ETA: 30 segundos.
Key.Chinesesimp: "骑士1-5"呼叫总部，我们快到了。预计到达时间：30秒。

Key.Original: We’re in position, preparing to fast-rope.
Key.English: We’re in position, preparing to fast-rope.
Key.German: Wir sind in Position, bereiten uns zum Abseilen vor.
Key.Spanish: Estamos en posición, preparando el descenso rápido.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们到了，准备部署索降。

Key.Spanish: ¡Vamos allá!

Key.Original: Overlord copies. Proceed with the mission.
Key.English: Overlord copies. Proceed with the mission.
Key.Spanish: "Overlord 1-1" recibido, continuad la misión.

Key.Original: Heads up: cash barely circulates out here. Your operational funds are in the supply crate at base, so spend wisely.
Key.English: Heads up: cash barely circulates out here. Your operational funds are in the supply crate at base, so spend wisely.
Key.German: Kurze Anmerkung: Die Währung ist in der Kampfzone noch eingeschränkt gültig. In Versorgungskisten der Basis gibt es Einsatzmittel – gebt sie sparsam aus.
Key.Spanish: Una nota rápida: la moneda aún circula de forma limitada en la zona de combate. Las cajas de suministros de la base contienen fondos operativos — úsalos con moderación.
Key.Chinesesimp: 顺便提一嘴，你们知道战区里的货币仍然勉强流通吧？基地内的补给箱里有一些行动资金————省着点花。

Key.German: Action Squad an "Overlord 1-1", wir sind in Position.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad a "Overlord 1-1", estamos en posición.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组呼叫"霸王1-1"，我们到了。

Key.German: Hier ist "Overlord 1-1". Eure harte Arbeit hat sich ausgezahlt.
Key.Spanish: Aquí es "Overlord 1-1". Vuestro duro trabajo ha dado frutos.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王1-1"，看来你们的辛苦工作有了回报。
Key.Original: This is Overlord. The zones you hold are paying out command points. Keep them secure.
Key.English: This is Overlord. The zones you hold are paying out command points. Keep them secure.

Key.German: Alle Einheiten im Einsatzgebiet, Achtung. Wir haben eine feindliche Zone eingenommen. Gut gemacht.
Key.Spanish: Todas las unidades en la zona de operaciones, atención. Hemos capturado una zona enemiga. Buen trabajo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 战区所有单位注意，我们占领了一个敌军据点。干得漂亮。
Key.Original: All units in the AO, be advised. We have secured an enemy zone. Well done.
Key.English: All units in the AO, be advised. We have secured an enemy zone. Well done.

Key.German: Hier ist "Overlord 1-1". Achtung, freundliche Einheiten haben eine Zone verloren.
Key.Spanish: Aquí es "Overlord 1-1". Atención, las fuerzas amigas han perdido una zona.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王1-1"，注意，友军丢失了一个据点。
Key.Original: This is Overlord. Be advised, friendly forces have lost a zone.
Key.English: This is Overlord. Be advised, friendly forces have lost a zone.

Key.German: Hier spricht "Oberherr 1-1", unser taktisches Mittel hat gerade die Beweglichkeit verloren. Die nahe gelegene Aufklärungsgruppe "Kurier 2-1" ist als Soforteinsatztruppe dorthin entsandt, um es zu schützen, braucht aber weitere Unterstützung. Vergiss nicht, das Toolkit mitzubringen, um bei Beschädigung des Mittels feldreparaturen durchzuführen.
Key.Spanish: Este es "Imperador 1-1", nuestro bien táctico acaba de perder la movilidad. La escuadra de reconocimiento "Envío Rápido 2-1", ubicada en sus proximidades, ha acudido como fuerza de respuesta rápida para protegerlo, pero necesita más refuerzos. No olvides traer la caja de herramientas para hacer reparaciones de campo si el bien sufre daños.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王1-1"，我们的战术资产在野外某地失去了机动能力，位于资产附近的侦察班组"速递2-1"已作为快反部队前去保护，但他们还需要更多支援。别忘了带上工具箱来在资产受损时进行战地维修。
Key.Original: This is Overlord. Our tactical asset has lost mobility. Recon fireteam Express 2-1 has moved in as QRF to secure it, but they need support. Bring a toolkit in case the asset needs field repairs.
Key.English: This is Overlord. Our tactical asset has lost mobility. Recon fireteam Express 2-1 has moved in as QRF to secure it, but they need support. Bring a toolkit in case the asset needs field repairs.

Key.German: "Kurier 2-1" an "Oberherr", wir sind als Soforteinsatztruppe am Standort der taktischen Mittel eingetroffen und eine Verteidigungslinie aufgebaut, wir brauchen dringende Unterstützung.
Key.Spanish: "Envío Rápido 2-1" a "Imperador", hemos llegado a los bienes tácticos como fuerza de respuesta rápida y establecido una línea defensiva, necesitamos refuerzos urgentemente.
Key.Chinesesimp: "速递2-1"呼叫"霸王"，我们已作为快反部队到达战术资产位置并建立防线，但仍需要额外部队支援。
Key.Original: Express 2-1 to Overlord, we're on the tactical asset and holding a perimeter. We need support, now.
Key.English: Express 2-1 to Overlord, we're on the tactical asset and holding a perimeter. We need support, now.

Key.German: Hey! Ihr seid endlich da! Es gibt einen Mörser in der Stellung, kann ihn einer von euch bedienen?
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! ¡Por fin llegáis! Hay un mortero en la posición, ¿alguno de vosotros sabe manejarlo?
Key.Chinesesimp: 嘿！你们终于来了！阵地里有台迫击炮，你们有人方便操作它吗？
Key.Original: You're finally here. There's a mortar on the position. Any of you know how to work it?
Key.English: You're finally here. There's a mortar on the position. Any of you know how to work it?

Key.Spanish: ¡Contacto!!

Key.German: „Allseher“ an „Kurier 2-1“, Warnung: Starkere Feindinfanteriebewegungen in Ihrer Umgebung erfasst, Stärke ca. eine Kompanie. Auf Kontakt vorbereiten, aus.
Key.Spanish: "Ojo Omnisciente" a "Envío Rápido 2-1", advertencia: detectados intensos movimientos de infantería enemiga alrededor de tu posición, fuerza de aproximadamente un pelotón. Prepárense para el contacto, fin.
Key.Chinesesimp: "全视眼"呼叫"速递2-1"，注意，我在你的位置周围发现大量敌人步兵活动，一个排左右，准备接战，完毕。
Key.Original: Allseer to Express 2-1, be advised: heavy infantry moving on your position, roughly platoon strength. Prepare for contact, over.
Key.English: Allseer to Express 2-1, be advised: heavy infantry moving on your position, roughly platoon strength. Prepare for contact, over.

Key.German: „Kurier 2-1“ an „Oberherr“, wir und die Verbündeten leiden schwere Verluste! Wo zur Hölle ist die Verstärkung?!
Key.Spanish: "Envío Rápido 2-1" a "Imperador", nosotros y las fuerzas aliadas sufrimos bajas graves! ¿Dónde carajo está el refuerzo?!
Key.Chinesesimp: "速递2-1"呼叫"霸王"，我们和友军严重减员！援军他妈的在哪？
Key.Original: Express 2-1 to Overlord, we're taking heavy casualties out here. Where the hell are those reinforcements?!
Key.English: Express 2-1 to Overlord, we're taking heavy casualties out here. Where the hell are those reinforcements?!

Key.German: „Delta 3-2“ an „Kurier“, wir bewegen uns als Soforteinsatztruppe zur Unterstützung Eurer Seite, voraussichtliche Ankunftszeit: 1 Minute!
Key.Spanish: "Delta 3-2" a "Envío Rápido", nos dirigimos a apoyarlos como fuerza de respuesta rápida, TEA: 1 minuto!
Key.Chinesesimp: "德尔塔3-2"呼叫"速递"，我们正作为快反部队前往支援你们，预计到达时间：1分钟
Key.Original: Delta 3-2 to Express, moving to support you as QRF. ETA one mike.
Key.English: Delta 3-2 to Express, moving to support you as QRF. ETA one mike.

Key.German: „Delta 3-2“ an „Kurier 2-1“, wir sind in Ihrer Umgebung eingetroffen und bekämpfen die Feinde! Ihr könnt euch kurz durchatmen!
Key.Spanish: "Delta 3-2" a "Envío Rápido 2-1", hemos llegado a vuestras proximidades y estamos combatiendo contra los enemigos! ¡Podéis respirar un momento!
Key.Chinesesimp: "德尔塔3-2"呼叫"速递2-1"，我们已经到达你们周围，正与敌军交战！你们可以歇口气了！
Key.Original: Delta 3-2 to Express 2-1, we're on station and engaging. Ease off, we've got them.
Key.English: Delta 3-2 to Express 2-1, we're on station and engaging. Ease off, we've got them.

Key.Spanish: Ha capturado exitosamente todas las zonas y completado la misión. Esta AO está ahora bajo control de BLUFOR. Bien hecho soldado.
¡Misión completada!

Key.German: Du hast erfolgreich alle Zonen erobert und die Mission abgeschlossen. Dieses Einsatzgebiet ist jetzt unter der Kontrolle von BLUFOR. Sehr gute Arbeit Soldat.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已经成功的夺取了所有战区并完成了任务。这个区域现在处于蓝方的控制下。干得漂亮！
Key.Original: You have successfully captured all the zones and completed the mission. This AO is now under BLUFOR control. Well done, soldier
Key.English: You have successfully captured all the zones and completed the mission. This AO is now under BLUFOR control. Well done, soldier

Key.Spanish: Oficial del CG asesinado

Key.German: Dein befehlshabender Offizier wurde getötet. Die Mission ist fehlgeschlagen, deine Evakuierung wird in kürze eingeleitet.
Key.Spanish: Tu oficial al mando ha muerto. La misión ha fracasado y serás evacuado en breve.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你的总部指挥官已经被杀了。任务失败了，立刻撤离！
Key.Original: Your commanding officer has been killed. The mission has failed and you will be evacuated shortly
Key.English: Your commanding officer has been killed. The mission has failed and you will be evacuated shortly

Key.Spanish: Demasiados CRIMENES DE GUERRA

Key.German: Du hast die Operation komplett verbockt. Die Mission ist fehlgeschlagen, deine Evakuierung wird in kürze eingeleitet.
Key.Spanish: Has fastidiado la operación. La misión ha fallado y serás evacuado en breve.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你把特种行动完全搞砸了。任务失败了，立刻撤离！
Key.Original: You completely botched the operation. The mission has failed and you will be evacuated shortly
Key.English: You completely botched the operation. The mission has failed and you will be evacuated shortly

Key.Spanish: <t color='#15ff00'>TERMINAR CAMPAÑA>></t>
<t color='#00ffff'>EXTENDER CAMPAÑA>></t>

Key.German: Hier ist "Overlord". Einige Zivilisten haben uns gerade dafür gedankt, dass wir die Ordnung aufrechterhalten. Gut gemacht, weiter so.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是"霸王"，刚刚有几个平民对我们维持秩序表达了感谢。干得不错，继续保持。
Key.Spanish: Aquí "Overlord". Algunos civiles acaban de agradecernos por mantener el orden. Buen trabajo, sigue así.
Key.Original: This is Overlord. Locals have been thanking us for keeping order. Good work, keep it up.
Key.English: This is Overlord. Locals have been thanking us for keeping order. Good work, keep it up.

Key.Spanish: Ubicación %1

Key.German: Ein Spieler hat eine Zone betreten: %1
Key.Spanish: Un jugador ha entrado a una zona: %1
Key.Original: A player has entered a zone: %1
Key.English: A player has entered a zone: %1

Key.German: Die Spieler haben die Zone verlassen: %1
Key.Spanish: Los jugadores han abandonado una zona: %1
Capturada: %1

Key.German: Verbündete Kräfte haben die Kontrolle über %1 erlangt
Key.Spanish: Fuerzas aliadas han tomado el control de: %1
Key.Original: Friendly forces have seized control of %1
Key.English: Friendly forces have seized control of %1

Key.Spanish: Perdida: %1

Key.German: Verbündete Kräfte haben die Kontrolle über %1 verloren
Key.Chinesesimp: 友军已经丧失了 %1 的控制权
Key.Spanish: Las fuerzas aliadas han perdido el control de: %1
Key.Original: Friendly forces have lost control of %1
Key.English: Friendly forces have lost control of %1

Key.Spanish: Missión fracazada

Key.German: Alle Einheiten im Einsatzgebiet, Achtung. Hier ist "Allseer". Wir haben gerade feindliche Angriffstruppen in der feindlichen Zone ausgemacht. Sie könnten auf das HQ oder freundliche Stellungen vorrücken. Bleibt wachsam!
Key.Spanish: Todas las unidades en la zona de operaciones, atención. Aquí es "Allseer". Acabamos de detectar fuerzas de asalto enemigas en la zona enemiga. Podrían avanzar hacia el HQ o las posiciones amigas. ¡Mantengan la alerta!
Key.Chinesesimp: 战区所有单位注意，这里是"全视眼"。我们刚刚在敌区发现了敌军的进攻部队。他们可能会朝总部或是友军据点进攻。注意警惕！
Key.Original: All units in the AO, this is Allseer. We've detected enemy assault forces staging in the zone. They may push toward HQ or friendly positions. Stay alert.
Key.English: All units in the AO, this is Allseer. We've detected enemy assault forces staging in the zone. They may push toward HQ or friendly positions. Stay alert.

Key.German: Alle Einheiten im Einsatzgebiet, Achtung. Wir haben eine feindliche Zone ausgemacht. Sie ist nun auf euren GPS-Terminals einsehbar.
Key.Spanish: Todas las unidades en la zona de operaciones, atención. Hemos localizado una zona enemiga. Ya es visible en vuestros terminales GPS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 战区所有单位注意，我们发现了一个敌区。现可在GPS终端查看。
Key.Original: All units in the AO, be advised. We have located an enemy zone. It is now visible on your GPS terminals.
Key.English: All units in the AO, be advised. We have located an enemy zone. It is now visible on your GPS terminals.

Key.German: ==AUFKLÄRUNGSDATEN GEFUNDEN==\n\nPosition aller Zonen wurden auf der Karte aufgedeckt.
Key.Spanish: ==Inteligencia recuperada==\n Todas las zonas han sido reveladas en el mapa.
Key.Chinesesimp: ==发现情报==\n\n地图上显示了所有战区。
Key.Original: ==INTEL RECOVERED==\n\nAll Zones have been revealed on the map.
Key.English: ==INTEL RECOVERED==\n\nAll Zones have been revealed on the map.

Key.Spanish: Guardado activado

Key.German:
Der Feind kontrolliert einige strategisch wichtige Zonen. Wir müssen diese Gebiete zurückerobern! Erobere für einen erfolgreichen Missionsabschluss alle vom Feind besetzten Zonen.
Du kannst BLUFOR helfen die Zonen zurückzuerobern und/oder sekundäre Missionen abschließen um die verfügbaren BLUFOR Ressourcen zu erhöhen. Während die Kampagne fortschreitet wird der Krieg eskalieren und die Armeen besseres Equipment nutzen und stärker werden.
Um eine Zone zu erobern muss unsere Präsenz der des Feindes überlegen sein.

Es liegt in deiner Hand, wie du die Mission spielen möchtest.
Viel Glück Soldat!
Key.Spanish:
El enemigo controla zonas críticas en el área ¡debemos retomarlas! Capture todas las zonas bajo control enemigo y la misión será un éxito.
Puede ayudar a BLUFOR a tomar las zonas y/o realizar misiones secundarias para incrementar los recursos de BLUFOR. Con el progreso de la campaña la guerra escalará y los ejércitos serán más fuertes
Para capturar una zona, necesitará una mayor presencia en la zona que el enemigo.

Depende de usted como quiera juagr esto.
¡Buena suerte, soldado!
Key.Chinesesimp:
敌人控制着该地区的一些关键地带，我们必须把它们夺回！占领敌人控制下的每个区域，任务就会成功。
你可以帮助BLUFOR占领区域和/或完成支线任务，以增加BLUFOR的资源。随着战役的推进，战争将升级，军队将变得更强大，并开始使用更大的资产。
要占领一个区域，你需要在该区域有比敌人更强大的存在。

这取决于你想怎么玩。
祝你好运，士兵!
Key.Original:
The enemy controls some critical zones in the area, and we need to take them back. Capture every zone under enemy control and the mission will succeed.
You can help BLUFOR take the zones and/or accomplish side missions to increase BLUFOR resources. As the campaign progresses, the war will escalate and the armies will get stronger and start to use bigger assets.
To capture a zone, you need to have a stronger presence in the zone than the enemy.

It's up to you how you want to play this.
Good luck, soldier!
Key.English:
The enemy controls some critical zones in the area, and we need to take them back. Capture every zone under enemy control and the mission will succeed.
You can help BLUFOR take the zones and/or accomplish side missions to increase BLUFOR resources. As the campaign progresses, the war will escalate and the armies will get stronger and start to use bigger assets.
To capture a zone, you need to have a stronger presence in the zone than the enemy.

It's up to you how you want to play this.
Good luck, soldier!

Key.Spanish: Capture las zonas
Campaña
¡Misión completada!

Key.German: Kehre zum HQ Offizier zurück um die Mission zu beenden.
Key.Spanish: Regrese con el oficial del CG para acabar la misión.
Key.Chinesesimp: 回到总部指挥官处来结束任务。
Key.Original: Return to the HQ OFFICER to End the Mission
Key.English: Return to the HQ OFFICER to End the Mission

Key.German: Kehre zum HQ Offizier zurück um die Kampagne zu verlängern oder die Mission zu beenden.
Key.Spanish: Regrese con el oficial del CG para extender o acabar la misión.
Key.Chinesesimp: 回到总部指挥官处扩展战役或结束任务。
Key.Original: Return to the HQ OFFICER to Extend the Campaign or End the Mission
Key.English: Return to the HQ OFFICER to Extend the Campaign or End the Mission

Key.German: Sichere alle besetzten Zonen oder verliere deine Assets.
Key.Spanish: Despeje todas las zonas ocupadas o perderá sus cosas.
Key.Chinesesimp: 清除所有被占领的战区。
Key.Original: Clear all remaining enemy zones, or the campaign will restart
Key.English: Clear all remaining enemy zones, or the campaign will restart

Key.German: Zwei Minuten bis die Kampagne neugestartet wird.
Key.Spanish: 2 minutos hasta que la campaña se reinicie.
CRÍMINES DE GUERRA
Edificios dañados: %1
Edificios destruídos!

Key.German: Irgendein BLUFOR Idiot hat zivile Gebäude zerstört. Ansehen nimmt ab.
Key.Spanish: Un idiota de BLUFOR destruyó varios edificios. Reduciendo reputación.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一个玩家摧毁了一些建筑，降低了声誉。
Key.Original: A BLUFOR unit destroyed buildings. Reputation reduced
Key.English: A BLUFOR unit destroyed buildings. Reputation reduced

Key.Spanish: Su reputación actual:
El juego ha sido guardado

Key.German: Action Squad, hier ist „Overlord 1-1“. Freundliche Einheiten haben gerade unsere gestohlene Munitionskiste in der Wildnis geortet. Rückt sofort aus, um sie zurückzuholen.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad, aquí es «Overlord 1-1». Las fuerzas amigas acaban de localizar nuestro cajón de munición robado en el campo. Salid inmediatamente para recuperarlo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组，这里是"霸王1-1"。友军刚刚在野外定位到了我们被抢走的弹药箱。你们需要立刻出发将它抢回来。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Friendly forces have located our stolen ammo crate out in the wilderness. Move out and recover it.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, this is Overlord. Friendly forces have located our stolen ammo crate out in the wilderness. Move out and recover it.

Key.German: Action Squad, verstanden. Wir rücken sofort aus.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad, recibido. Salimos inmediatamente.

Key.German: Action Squad an "Overlord 1-1", die Versorgungskiste wurde zum nächsten Stützpunkt geliefert.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad a "Overlord 1-1", el cajón de suministros ha sido entregado a la base más cercana.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组呼叫"霸王1-1"，补给箱已经送到了最近的基地。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord, the supply crate's been delivered to the nearest base.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord, the supply crate's been delivered to the nearest base.

Key.German: Action Squad an "Overlord 1-1"... Die Versorgungskiste wurde von den Feinden zerstört.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad a "Overlord 1-1"... El cajón de suministros ha sido destruido por el enemigo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 行动组呼叫"霸王1-1"...补给箱被敌人毁掉了...
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord... the supply crate's been destroyed.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1 to Overlord... the supply crate's been destroyed.

Key.German: Verstanden. Zieht euch zurück. Sicherheit geht vor.
Key.Spanish: Recibido. Retroceded. La seguridad es lo primero.
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到，你们撤出来吧。安全第一。

Key.Spanish: Equipo de Asalto de Rescate
Robar camión de suministros
Eliminar objetivo de alto valor
Destruir torre de señal
Rescatar piloto
Caza de Francotiradores
Robar camión de construcción
Eliminar al comandante del tanque
Destruir el portátil
Destruir el arsenal
Destruir el radar
Limpiar zona
Proteger activo táctico
Cazar pelotón blindado
Proteger al informante
Recuperar camión de suministros humanitarios
Key.Chinesesimp: 夺回人道主义物资卡车

Key.Spanish: Puesto de Mando de Asalto
Cazar observador de mortero

Key.German: Bewege dich sofort, um den feindlichen Mörserbeobachter zu eliminieren.
Key.Spanish: Muévete inmediatamente para eliminar al observador de mortero enemigo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 立刻前往消灭敌人的迫击炮观察员。
Key.Original: Move immediately to eliminate the enemy mortar observer.
Key.English: Move immediately to eliminate the enemy mortar observer.

Key.Spanish: Mortero!!!
